objective: Compute the global homogeneous compatibility remainder of the exact completed four-Cauchy plus prime-dilation source system and determine whether it cancels by an explicit identity independent of inversion or KNC.

operator_passport.state: C_f(z)=(2 pi i)^(-1) integral_(J_a) f(Y)/(Y-z) dY together with its four root-of-unity rotations, two endpoint/moment channels, and all active prime-dilation traces
operator_passport.target: A displayed bounded or closable T_src with Gamma=T_src A on the smooth localized core

allowed_operations: Plemelj jump and average identities with fixed orientation
exact Cauchy scale covariance under positive dilations
both interval boundaries and reflection X->1/X
rank-two exponential completion and the local completion term
every active prime-power dilation with Lambda(m)/sqrt(m)
finite noncommutative operator words and infinite systems only with independently proved convergence or closure
forbidden_imports: A_a inverse, pseudoinverse, resolvent limit, or quotient division
KNC, later positivity, a zero-free strip, or RH
discarding the homogeneous Cauchy state or diagonal counterterm
replacing the bilateral/two-boundary problem by a one-sided Volterra equation
promoting a finite-node or finite-prime calculation to the analytic zeta operator
fast_falsifiers: Check whether the old equation constrains a Cauchy jump, average, or both; a zero average may leave a free exterior Cauchy state.
Use an exact finite-Hilbert-transform/arcsine state to test local determinant-one propagation.
Compute the projection-dilation boundary cocycle and its closure under products and ratios of prime dilations.
Search exact finite-node Cauchy-dilation systems for homogeneous old states with nonzero exterior readout.
Reduce every proposed cancellation on a contact state and verify that it does not merely restate Gamma ker(A)=0.
success_criterion: An explicit identity for the genuine completed-zeta coefficients expressing the exterior readout solely in terms of A_a f, with independent boundedness or closability.
failure_classification: If the computed global compatibility datum is a free homogeneous period/readout whose vanishing is exactly Gamma ker(A)=0, the four-Cauchy representation is retained as a normal form but not as a reduction.
global_nonclaim: No completed-source factor, uniform zero-free strip, sharp four-cycle bound, or RH proof is assumed.
